status: mass+x-y-time-only 500-m donor-support preflight frozen before any body-mass vertical donor scores
role: post-freeze exploratory morphology mechanism test in the four structurally evaluable non-Eidolon panels; cannot alter v0.3.8
hypothesis_origin: Opened after 500-m place×speed×turn identity remained significant in all four structurally evaluable panels.

feasibility.target_population: only individuals structurally evaluable in the frozen 500-m place×speed×turn preflight
feasibility.donor_support: For each target session and each other-individual donor in the same frozen cohort, a target endpoint is supported when its 500-m cell×speed×turn state occurs in at least one retained donor session.
feasibility.donor_pair_evaluable: at least one target session has >=50 donor-supported endpoints
feasibility.target_individual_evaluable: at least 4 donor individuals with finite mass and at least 3 distinct absolute donor-target mass differences
feasibility.panel_gate: retain at least 70% of the frozen 500-m baseline n and at least 5 target individuals
feasibility.decision: If all four panels pass, freeze exact target n before opening any vertical donor-gradient outcome; otherwise stop this four-panel family.

planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.target_question: Among other individuals observed in the same 500-m place×speed×turn context, do body-mass-similar donors transfer vertical organization better?
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.donor_profile: equal-session P(centered residual height | 500-m cell, speed×turn state) from one donor individual's retained sessions
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.target_donor_score: equal-session mean target log donor-profile probability on donor-supported target endpoints, minus the equal-individual population of all other eligible donors on the same target support
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.target_statistic: Spearman rho between absolute donor-target mass difference and donor predictive gain; expected negative
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.null: permute body-mass labels among eligible donor/target individuals within frozen cohort while leaving all donor predictive scores and support fixed
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.panel_support_rule: observed equal-target mean rho < 0 and one-sided p(null <= observed)<=0.05
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 3 or 4 supporting panels => body-mass similarity is a recurring predictor of within-context vertical organization; 1 or 2 => context-dependent; 0 => simple body mass is not a general mechanism.

claim_boundary: Body mass is not wing loading or full morphology.
A negative gradient is associative, not causal.
Failure does not rule out wing shape, experience, memory or other stable traits.
This family is opened after fine-place persistence was observed and is exploratory mechanism localization, not independent confirmation.
This extension remains outside frozen v0.3.8.
stop_rule: Do not change the 500-m baseline population, >=50 donor support, >=4 donors, >=3 distinct mass distances, 70% panel gate, >=5 target floor, or panel set after preflight output.
Do not inspect vertical donor scores before the preflight passes and exact n is frozen.
Do not group mass or substitute tag mass/sex if the continuous gradient fails.
